headline: Prime angle but pint-sized — glassy dawn log session.
today: That SE swell hits Lido at the prime peeling angle, just small at 2ft and 5.7s. Offshore NNW-N at dawn and through the morning keeps it clean before SW cross-on creeps in by afternoon. Log it early on the push toward the 8:49a high; don't expect much from the afternoon.

daysToWatch.note: Prime angle again with size to 2.8ft, but only clean at first light before SW turns it onshore. Early or not at all.
